skills.name: character_body_kinematic_controller
skills.skill: Implement robust kinematic 2D/3D player controllers using CharacterBody2D/CharacterBody3D with proper delta scaling, gravity, variable jump, and slope handling.
procedure: Select CharacterBody2D or CharacterBody3D as root node for player entities.
Declare explicit exports for move_speed, acceleration, friction, jump_velocity, and gravity vector.
Process input actions inside _physics_process(delta) using Input.get_vector() or Input.get_axis().
Apply directional acceleration towards target velocity using move_toward() or lerp() to prevent abrupt stops.
Check is_on_floor() before applying gravity or permitting jump initiation.
Execute move_and_slide() without passing velocity as an argument (reading and writing the built-in self.velocity property).
Inspect get_platform_velocity() and configure floor_snap_length / floor_stop_on_slope to prevent bouncing down slopes.
verification: Assert velocity is modified prior to move_and_slide() invocation.
Verify character grounded status toggles accurately on flat ground and ramps.
Confirm jump height is independent of physics tick rate (engine/physics/common/physics_ticks_per_second).
pitfalls: Do not multiply velocity by delta before calling move_and_slide(); Godot 4 automatically integrates delta.
Never modify global_position directly on kinematic bodies during movement loops, as this bypasses collision solver manifolds.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Create a complete CharacterBody3D GDScript script with smooth acceleration, coyote time, jump buffering, and proper slope snapping for Godot 4.7.2.

skills.name: animation_tree_hierarchical_state_machine
skills.skill: Construct and drive hierarchical animation blending systems using AnimationMixer, AnimationPlayer, and AnimationTree with state machine playbacks.
procedure: Attach an AnimationPlayer to the rig containing base clips (idle, run, jump, fall, attack).
Add an AnimationTree node, assign the anim_player property to the AnimationPlayer, and set tree_root to an AnimationNodeStateMachine.
Configure internal states using AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D/2D for directional locomotion and AnimationNodeOneShot for upper-body actions.
Establish AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition connections with appropriate switch modes (IMMEDIATE, SYNC, AT_END) and advance expressions or conditions.
Activate the AnimationTree via active = true.
In GDScript, query the state machine playback via: var state_machine = get_node("AnimationTree").get("parameters/playback") as AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback.
Trigger state changes using state_machine.travel("StateName") and update blend positions via set("parameters/BlendSpace2D/blend_position", vector).
verification: Verify animation playback smoothly blends between distinct locomotion velocities without T-pose flickers.
Ensure transition conditions do not cause recursive state loops in the same frame.
Check that state_machine.is_playing() and state_machine.get_current_node() reflect expected states.
pitfalls: Failing to mark AnimationTree active in code or editor will freeze playback silently.
Accessing incorrect parameter paths (e.g. mismatched case or missing 'parameters/' prefix) results in runtime null references.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Write a GDScript controller that feeds input vectors and combat trigger flags into an AnimationTree using AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback and a 2D blend space.

skills.name: polyphonic_audio_emitter_pool
skills.skill: Design high-throughput, low-latency sound effect pipelines utilizing AudioStreamPolyphonic and AudioStreamPlayer without audio dropouts.
procedure: Create an AudioStreamPlayer (or 2D/3D variant) and assign an AudioStreamPolyphonic resource to stream.
Set polyphony parameter to accommodate max concurrent sounds (e.g., 16–32 voices).
Obtain the playback stream in code using: var poly_playback = audio_player.get_stream_playback() as AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.
Encapsulate playback requests into a function accepting an AudioStream sample, pitch variance, and volume offset.
Play individual voices with poly_playback.play_stream(sample, offset, volume_db, pitch_scale).
Track returned stream IDs to allow premature cancellation or dynamic attenuation with poly_playback.stop_stream(id).
verification: Verify multiple instances of the same sound overlap without clipping or voice starvation.
Check memory allocations via AudioServer to ensure stream references are freed properly after termination.
Measure audio latency and buffer under-runs under high-frequency firing conditions.
pitfalls: AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic can only be fetched after the parent AudioStreamPlayer is active in the scene tree and playing.
Exceeding the max_polyphony voice limit will silently drop oldest or newest voices based on engine voice allocation heuristics.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Implement a GDScript audio manager node utilizing AudioStreamPolyphonic to play pooled positional impact sounds with randomized pitch and volume.

skills.name: procedural_grid_pathfinding
skills.skill: Implement high-performance 2D and 3D grid pathfinding using AStarGrid2D and AStar3D with weighted navigation and obstacle rasterization.
procedure: Instantiate AStarGrid2D for uniform 2D grids or AStar3D for arbitrary 3D topological graphs.
For AStarGrid2D, configure region Rect2i, cell_size, and update().
Set diagonal_mode (e.g., DIAGONAL_MODE_NEVER, ALWAYS, or AT_LEAST_ONE_WALKABLE) and default_compute_heuristic.
Iterate over obstacle collision layers or TileMap patterns and invoke set_point_solid(coord, true) for unpassable cells.
Apply terrain traversal penalties using set_point_weight_scale(coord, weight).
Compute navigation paths using get_point_path(from_coord, to_coord) and convert grid coordinates to world positions.
verification: Verify paths avoid solid tiles completely across corner traversals.
Validate path query performance over large grids (e.g., 500x500 cells executed under 2ms).
Ensure start or end points on solid nodes degrade gracefully using is_point_solid() checks before querying.
pitfalls: Calling AStarGrid2D point-editing functions without invoking update() first causes invalid bounds errors.
Mixing local grid indices (Vector2i) with world-space coordinates (Vector2) leads to out-of-bound graph queries.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Construct an AStarGrid2D pathfinder class in GDScript that synchronizes solid points from a TileMapLayer and provides smoothed world-coordinate path slices.

skills.name: responsive_ui_layout_engine
skills.skill: Build resolution-agnostic, responsive UI systems utilizing Container hierarchies (BoxContainer, CenterContainer, AspectRatioContainer) and anchor-offset math.
procedure: Establish UI roots on CanvasLayer nodes with a top-level Control configured to full-rect anchors (anchor_right = 1.0, anchor_bottom = 1.0).
Nest structural containers (MarginContainer -> VBoxContainer/HBoxContainer) to handle automatic layout calculation.
Configure size_flags_horizontal and size_flags_vertical (SIZE_EXPAND, SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER, SIZE_FILL) explicitly on child Controls.
Enforce specific aspect ratios for previews/cards using AspectRatioContainer.
Apply Theme resources containing StyleBoxFlat or StyleBoxTexture variations for uniform style propagation.
Implement dynamic layout readjustment handling by listening to viewport size_changed signals when programmatic repositioning is necessary.
verification: Preview scene across multiple aspect ratios (16:9, 21:9, 4:3, 9:16 mobile) and verify no control overlapping or boundary clipping occurs.
Ensure min_size constraints prevent text truncation in Label and Button nodes.
Confirm UI elements properly accept or ignore mouse input based on mouse_filter settings (MOUSE_FILTER_PASS, STOP, IGNORE).
pitfalls: Manually setting custom_minimum_size or position on direct children of Containers will get overridden by container layout passes.
Leaving mouse_filter as STOP on full-screen container overlays will unintentionally block gameplay input underneath.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Create a responsive pause menu UI layout in Godot 4.7.2 with animated modal background, centered button stack, audio sliders, and multi-resolution support.
